findings.description: Cross-artifact authority/work-order/quota/eligibility/package/dependency bindings are not validated completely. Contradictory but syntactically valid repository pointers can still produce CODEX_EXECUTION_CANDIDATE.
findings.concrete_counterexample: Change CURRENT_CODEX.yaml quota_amendment.amendment_id while keeping quota_amendment.path pointed at the unchanged valid amendment document. The current resolver loads the valid path but does not compare the CURRENT amendment_id to the loaded amendment document identity, so the mismatch can survive and candidate routing can still be returned.
missing_binding_classes: CURRENT/WORK authorization_path and authorization_state vs loaded authorization identity/state
CURRENT/WORK eligibility_path and execution_eligibility vs loaded eligibility identity/status
quota exact_binding work_order_path/base_authorization_path/executor_profile vs canonical current/work/auth binding
dependency closure identity vs authorization program_binding.package_dependency
executor profile consistency between quota amendment and authorization exact_binding.allowed_executor_profile
related pointer/identity/revision/state mismatches that must fail closed rather than route a candidate
